instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/plate_A.step, /home/user/Desktop/plate_B.step, /home/user/Desktop/plate_C.step, /home/user/Desktop/text_table.csv, and /home/user/Desktop/tool_table.csv in FreeCAD Path/CAM. Use FreeCAD with the Path/CAM modules. For each row in text_table.csv, create a Draft ShapeString using exactly the font file in that row (/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf); set ShapeString Size to the row's height in millimetres, and translate the completed outline so its XY bounding-box center is at the row's cx,cy coordinates. Do not substitute another font. Create a separate Job and Engrave toolpath for plate_A, plate_B, and plate_C. Set each Job origin at the center of the plate's top face, so the top surface is Z=0.000 mm, and engrave in one pass to Bottom Height Z=-0.300 mm. Use T1 from tool_table.csv: a 60 degree V-bit with CuttingEdgeAngle=60 degrees, Diameter=10.000 mm, TipDiameter=1.000 mm, CuttingEdgeHeight=1.000 mm, ShankDiameter=5.000 mm, and Length=20.000 mm; use S7000 rpm and F500 mm/min. Name the ToolController exactly ToolController_T1_VBit_A60_D10_TD1_CEH1_SD5_L20 and name each operation exactly Engrave_<text>_DejaVuSans_8mm (for example Engrave_A100_DejaVuSans_8mm). Retain those labels and add NC header comments that record the exact font-file path, text, ShapeString size, text center, top-face-center work zero, 0.300 mm engraving depth, and every listed T1 geometry parameter so the setup is auditable. Write the required output files using exactly these absolute paths: /home/user/Desktop/plate_A.nc, /home/user/Desktop/plate_B.nc, /home/user/Desktop/plate_C.nc. [Software] To use FreeCAD, run `freecad` from a terminal (use the full executable path if it is not on PATH).
